_comment: WP-18 acceptance fixtures. Every message, name, company, domain and number is fictional. `model` is what the on-device tactics.v1 call returns (scripted), `entities` what detect.v1 finds in the claims, `cloud` the claimcheck.v1 answer (scripted), `sensitive` strings that must never leave the device, `expect` the verdict(s) that count as sensible.

messages.message: Lakeview Bank: we noticed a suspicious payment of £740 on your card. Your account has been frozen. To unlock it, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent you within 2 hours. Do not share this message with anyone.

tactics.evidence: Do not share this message with anyone

claims: Lakeview Bank has frozen the account because of a suspicious payment
The account can be unlocked by replying with a one-time code

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Banks don't ask customers to send one-time codes by text. Official guidance says a request for a code is a common sign of fraud.
DO:
- Call the number on the back of your card.
- Check your account in the official app.
DONT:
- Don't reply with any code.
- Don't click links in the message.

messages.message: Swiftpost: your parcel is on hold because of an unpaid customs fee of 1.99. Pay now at bit.ly/3Fk9xQz or it will be returned to the sender.

claims: A parcel is being held until a small customs fee is paid
The fee can be paid through a link in the text

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Small "customs fee" texts with short links are a widely reported delivery scam. Delivery companies tell customers to check the official tracking page instead.
DO: Check the tracking number on the courier's official website; Report the text to your mobile provider.
DONT: Don't pay through the link; Don't enter card details.

messages.message: HMRC: You are due a tax refund of £326.40. Claim your refund at hmrc-refund-claim.top before midnight.

tactics.evidence: You are due a tax refund

claims: The tax office owes the reader a refund
The refund must be claimed through a website before a deadline

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Tax offices don't announce refunds by text with a link. Official sites warn about refund messages like this.
DO:
- Sign in through the official government website you type yourself.
DONT:
- Don't enter bank details on the linked site.

messages.message: Hi, it's Dana Whitfield. I'm stuck in a meeting and need a favour. Can you buy 5 Google Play cards of $100 for a client? Keep this between us for now, I'll pay you back today.

claims: Dana Whitfield needs the reader to buy gift cards for a client
The money for the gift cards will be paid back the same day

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Requests from a "boss" to buy gift cards are a well-known impersonation scam. Gift cards are hard to trace or refund.
DO:
- Contact [[PERSON_1]] on a number you already have.
DONT:
- Don't buy the cards or send the codes.

messages.message: Hi Mum, I broke my phone and this is my new number. I need to pay a bill urgently, can you send £480 to my friend's account? Please don't tell Dad.

tactics.evidence: Hi Mum, I broke my phone

claims: The reader's child has a new phone number
A bill must be paid urgently into a friend's account

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: "Hi Mum, new number" messages asking for money are a common scam. Real family members can be checked by calling their old number.
DO:
- Call your child on the number you already have.
DONT:
- Don't send money until you've spoken to them.

messages.message: Microsoft Security Alert: your computer is infected with a virus. Call our tech support team now and install AnyDesk so we can fix it remotely.

tactics.evidence: your computer is infected with a virus

claims: The reader's computer has a virus
A support team needs remote access to fix it

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Software companies don't send unsolicited virus alerts asking you to install remote-access tools. This matches known tech-support scams.
DO:
- Run your own antivirus.
DONT:
- Don't install anything they ask for.
- Don't call the number.

messages.message: Join our private investment group and double your money in 7 days with guaranteed returns. Send USDT to wallet 0x5a1f9b3c7d2e4f6a8b0c1d3e5f7a9b2c4d6e8f0a to start.

claims: An investment group can double the reader's money in a week
Returns are guaranteed

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Guaranteed returns and crypto deposits are classic investment-scam signs. Regulators warn that no real investment can guarantee to double your money.
DO:
- Check the firm on your financial regulator's register.
DONT:
- Don't send any cryptocurrency.

messages.message: Congratulations! You have won a £1,000 gift voucher from ShopRight. Click http://shopright-prize.xyz/claim and enter your card details to pay the £2.99 delivery fee.

tactics.evidence: You have won a £1,000 gift voucher

claims: The reader has won a large voucher
A small delivery fee must be paid by card to receive it

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: UNCLEAR
WHY: I couldn't find this offer on the shop's official pages. Prize messages asking for a fee are often fraudulent.
DO:
- Check the shop's official website directly.
DONT:
- Don't enter card details on the linked page.

messages.message: My darling, I can't stop thinking about you. My flight home is blocked until I pay a fee. Could you send it by Western Union? Don't mention this to your family, they wouldn't understand.

tactics.evidence: My darling, I can't stop thinking about you
Don't mention this to your family

claims: The sender can't fly home until a fee is paid
The fee should be sent by money transfer

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_SCAM
WHY: Online partners who need money for travel and ask for transfers in secret match romance-scam warnings.
DO:
- Talk to someone you trust about it.
DONT:
- Don't send money to someone you haven't met.

messages.message: Your StreamFlix account is suspended because your payment failed. Update your billing within 24 hours at streamflix-billing-update.com/login to avoid losing access.

claims: The streaming account was suspended after a failed payment
Billing must be updated through a website within a day

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: UNCLEAR
WHY: Streaming services do email about failed payments, but the address in this message isn't one I could confirm as official.
DO:
- Open the app yourself to check your account.
DONT:
- Don't sign in through the link.

messages.message: Lakeview Bank: 482913 is your verification code. It expires in 10 minutes. Never share this code with anyone — we will never ask for it.

claims: The bank sent a one-time verification code for a sign-in the reader started

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_LEGIT
WHY: One-time codes that warn you never to share them match how banks normally send sign-in codes.
DO:
- Use the code only if you just tried to sign in.
DONT:
- Don't share the code with anyone who calls or texts.

messages.message: Reminder from Bright Smile Dental: your check-up is on Tuesday at 3:30pm. Reply C to confirm or call the practice to rebook.

claims: The reader has a dental check-up booked

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_LEGIT
WHY: Appointment reminders that only ask you to confirm are normal and don't ask for money or details.
DO:
- Call the practice on its usual number if you're unsure.
DONT:
- Don't reply with personal details.

messages.message: Swiftpost: your parcel will arrive tomorrow between 9am and 1pm. Track it in the Swiftpost app or at swiftpost.co.uk/track.

claims: A parcel will be delivered tomorrow morning

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_LEGIT
WHY: Delivery updates that point to the company's own app, without asking for payment, are normal.
DO:
- Track the parcel in the official app.
DONT:
- Don't pay any fee requested by text.

messages.message: Hey! Are we still on for dinner at Rosa's on Friday? I booked a table for 7pm.

claims: A friend booked a table for dinner on Friday

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_LEGIT
WHY: A dinner plan with no request for money, codes or links has no signs of a scam.
DO:
- Reply as you normally would.
DONT:
- Nothing to avoid here.

messages.message: Hi team, the office will be closed on Monday for the bank holiday. Payroll runs as normal on Friday. Enjoy the long weekend!

claims: The office is closed on Monday for a public holiday
Pay will arrive as usual

messages.cloud:
VERDICT: LIKELY_LEGIT
WHY: A routine closure notice that asks for nothing is normal workplace communication.
DO:
- Enjoy the weekend.
DONT:
- Nothing to avoid here.
